reviews.text: This project is for those seeking a simple yet intense and engaging arcade experience, featuring a unique protagonist.
Crazy rabbit-fighting game with role-playing upgrades. Explosive carrots, ear attacks - it was great. Fast, chaotic, and funny. It's perfect for a beer in the evening
A wild rabbit with a role-playing upgrade. It explodes with carrots and attacks with its ears, which is something. It's fast, chaotic, and funny. It's perfect with a beer. It's a good option

This game is unexpectedly addictive! It combines fast-paced gameplay with humor perfectly everything works in great harmony. Playing as a furious rabbit is incredibly satisfying: the fights are unpredictable, the unlockable upgrades are amusing, and the overall atmosphere is light and easygoing. A great choice if you’re looking for something unusual and entertaining!

Crazy Bunny is a simple and very fun game where you play as an angry rabbit and just create total chaos in the arenaThe gameplay is fast and noisy you are constantly fighting waves of enemies getting random upgrades and collecting weird abilities that change every runThe game is not serious and is more about fun than difficulty it is bright funny and perfect for just relaxing and having a bit of silly fun
This game is very enjoyable and well designed. The gameplay feels smooth and balanced, and it keeps you entertained from start to finish. I truly recommend it!
Primitive interface, normal graphics, the game difficulty is very easy, it's okay to play a couple of times

Floppy-Ear Chaos is an explosive cocktail of dynamics, humor, and charm! A great soundtrack, crazy gameplay, and a cute main character. It's addictive from the first second, and you won't get bored. I highly recommend it!

Fast, funny, and seriously chaotic! Playing as a furious rabbit with explosive carrots never gets old. The roguelite progression keeps every run fresh, and the comic art style is a blast. A perfect pick for a quick adrenaline fix.

Crazy Bunny is an absolute blast! I thought the Vampire Survivors genre was getting stale, but this game proves otherwise. Playing as an angry rabbit causing total chaos feels fresh and hilarious. The gameplay is fast, smooth, and surprisingly addictive. Upgrades are random, fights are unpredictable, and the humor is spot-on. Perfect for casual fun or quick sessions. Highly recommended!
Floppy-Ear Chaos is a delightful and engaging game! The colorful graphics and fun gameplay keep you entertained for hours. Highly recommend for all ages!

A fast-paced fighting game about an angry rabbit. You defeat waves of enemies, pick up random upgrades, and scream at the sights. The comic book style is fun, but it gets boring after an hour. For the price, it's okay.

Fast, funny, and furiously chaotic! Play as a crazy rabbit brawling through cartoon waves. Absurd upgrades like explosive carrots & spinning ears. Roguelite runs keep it fresh. No Chinese yet, but pure beat 'em up joy. Short, punchy, worth the chaos!
Mad rabbit brawler! Fast, funny, chaotic roguelite. Spin ears, throw explosive carrots, smash enemies. Absurd upgrades & comic art style.
a cool game with good graphics and a great design. I liked the music in this game, and I'll be playing it again. Thank you.
I was starting to think the Vampire Survivors genre was on its last legs, but no — there are still enthusiasts out there who keep adding more and more interesting mechanics every now and then.
angry bunny brawls through waves with wild perks cool comic looks but gets dull fast worth it for the cost
Received as a gift from a friend, the game did not disappoint. The art made by ii was disappointing, but the game itself was cool
I recently played Floppy Ear: Chaos and I have to say, it’s a surprisingly fun and engaging game)) The graphics are charming and cartoony, which gives it a light-hearted, family-friendly vibe.

Great game overall! Super fun, and easy to learn. Some key notes for the dev team: - On the level select screen, it's unclear what the requirements are for unlocking the next map/difficulty. A good suggestion is some text under the lock (upgrade to lvl ?? to unlock) - On the desert map, the boss gets stuck on a lot of terrain, making that level super easy to cheese your way through. To increase difficulty/playability, you might spread the rocks out just a tad more (or shrink a couple of them) - On the frosty map, there's a glitch in your code that ends the game as soon as the final boss spawns. No combat necessary. - On the forest map (medium difficulty) there's a glitch in the code where no mobs spawn at all. The timer runs out and the game ends, but not a single spawn was found. Overall, though, I thoroughly enjoyed playing this game, and look forward to future projects from this developer!
